definitions.short: Jehojada , the name of three Israelites
definitions.full: H3077. Yehoyada יוֺיָדָע יְהוֺיָדָע, proper name, masculine ( ׳י knoweth ; compare אֶלְיָדָע יְדַעְיָה, & references, בְּעֶלְיָדָע ) — 1 ׳יְהוֺ ; ᵐ5 usually Ἰωδαε , A sometimes Ἰωιαδαε ( 2Sam 23:30 + ), ᵐ5 L Ἰωαδ ( 20:23 ὠαδδαι ), father of Benaiah (David's time), in combination בֶּןיְֿהוֺ ׳בְּנָיָהוּ 8:18 ; 20:23 ; 23:20 , 22 ; 1Kin 1:8 , 26 , 32 , 36 , 38 , 44 ; 2:25 , 29 , 34 , 35 , 46 ; 4:4 ; 1Chr 11:22 , 24 ; 18:17 ; 27:5 ; בֶּןבְּֿנָיָהוּ יְהוֺיָדָע 27:34 is probably erroneous inversion of the usual order; ׳יְהוֺ alone only 12:28 (where called לְאַחֲרֹן הַנָּגִיד ). 2 ᵐ5 ׳יְהוֺ, usually Ἰωδαε A sometimes Ἰωιαδαε etc., (chief) priest at Jerusalem in time of Joash 2Kin 11:4 , 9 (twice in verse); 11:15 , 17 ; 12:3 ; 12:8 ; 12:10 ; 2Chr 22:11 ; 23:1 , 8 (twice in verse); 23:9 , 11 , 14 , 16 , 18 ; 24:2-3 , 6 , 12 , 14 (twice in verse); 24:15 ; 24:17 ; 24:20 ; 24:22 ; 24:25 ; Jer 29:26 . 3 יוֺיָדָע a builder at wall of Jerusalem, with Nehemiah, Neh 3:6 ( ᵐ5 Ἰοειαα , Ἰοειδα , Ἰωδαε etc.) 4 ׳יוֺ son of high priest Eliashib Neh 12:10-11 , 22 ; 13:28 ( ᵐ5 Ἰωδα , Ἰωαδαε , Ἰωιαδα ).
